# Daily Planner — Goals Tracker

> Your personal motivation and tasks assistant. Manage daily tasks, set routines, track goals, and stay focused — simply and effectively.

Daily Planner is a productivity app for iOS and Android that helps users plan tasks, visualize progress, and build consistent daily routines. Designed for people who find most planning apps overcomplicated.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://pcristo.dev/dailyplanner_website/): Features and download
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/daily-planner-goals-tracker/id6757503582): Download on iOS
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pcdreams.dailyplanner): Download on Android
- [Privacy Policy](https://pcristo.dev/dailyplanner_website/privacy.html)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://pcristo.dev/dailyplanner_website/terms.html)

## Features

- **Interactive UI Widgets** — Interactive timeline and calendar; simple, intuitive interface
- **Daily Task & Goal Planning** — Track goals and completion progress; stay motivated with visual status
- **Custom Routine Scheduling** — Schedule, update, and delete recurring (Pro) plans
- **Unlimited Tasks & Reminders** — Plan days, weeks, or months ahead (Pro); never miss important items

## Pricing

- **Free** — Core task planning features
- **Pro** — Recurring plans, unlimited tasks, extended reminders (in-app purchase)

## Availability

- iOS (App Store) — Free to download
- Android (Google Play) — Free to download
- App Store ID: 6757503582
- Google Play package: com.pcdreams.dailyplanner
